name: wl-race-closed
_comment: A windward-leeward that CLOSES, for ticket 10 round 4.
The first cut sailed headings for a duration, so the beat and the run did not
cancel and the course marched 4.3 km downrange — roundings never clustered, so
'which marks was this leg between' could not even be asked.
Here the run legs are the reciprocals of the beat legs (0/90 against 180/270)
and their duration is set so net displacement cancels: upwind VMG over 480 s
is about 1100 m, downwind VMG at TWA 135 covers that in about 286 s.
TWD 225. Beat TWA 45 on 180/270 (J1), run TWA 135 on 0/90 (A3).
GROUND TRUTH: lap = 766 s. Boundaries at 480, 766, 1246, 1532, ... alternating.
